title: Align GLOBAL session briefs with lead-owned claims
body:
GLOBAL `scripts/hooks/krn_capsule.py:27,265` and the opencode plugin `config/opencode/plugins/krn.js:21,169` tell every session to run `krn task claim <id> --actor <actor>`, and `skills/engineering/delivery-loop/SKILL.md:36-38` lets workers mutate the queue unless assigned. KRN-11 says only the lead claims; workers receive the id in their brief (review N3).
Acceptance: session briefs and the delivery-loop skill state that the lead manages claims and workers never mutate tracker state; tests cover the brief text.
